title: vSafeMobs
description: Spawn Mobs, with custom attributes. Such as (scale, health, AI, attack, e.t.c.)
body:
# vSafemobs by vProLabs

Spawn safe mobs that move naturally but won't attack players. Perfect for decoration, RPG servers, or pet systems!

![vSafeMobs banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b002f205cbb1a8153f5e899bd6aed80b6eac57a.png)

> If you find any bugs, report them on our [discord](https://discord.gg/SNzUYWbc5Q)!

## ✨ Full Features

**Safe Mob Spawning**
- Spawn any mob with `noattack:true` - they move freely but can't hurt players
- `leadable:true` - Put ANY mob on a lead (even Wardens!)
- Full attribute customization (health, speed, scale, name, etc.)

**Mob Management**
- Kill specific mobs by ID
- Kill all safe mobs at once
- List all tracked safe mobs
- Persistent tracking across server restarts

**Available Attributes**
| Attribute | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `noattack` | Mob won't target or damage players |
| `leadable` | Mob can be put on a lead |
| `silent` | Mob makes no sounds |
| `invulnerable` | Mob takes no damage |
| `persistent` | Mob won't despawn |
| `baby` | Spawn as baby variant |
| `glow` | Mob has glowing effect |
| `nogravity` | Mob ignores gravity |
| `custommodel` | Custom model data (stick in hand) |
| `health` | Set max health |
| `speed` | Set movement speed |
| `scale` | Set entity scale/size |
| `name` | Custom name with color codes |
| `team` | Assign to scoreboard team |

---

## 🚀 Commands

| Command | Aliases | Description | Permission |
|---------|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/vsm spawn <type> [attr:value]...` | `/vsafemobs spawn` | Spawn a safe mob | `vsafemobs.spawn` |
| `/vsm kill <id>` | `/vsafemobs kill` | Kill specific mob by ID | `vsafemobs.admin` |
| `/vsm killall` | `/vsafemobs killall` | Kill all safe mobs | `vsafemobs.admin` |
| `/vsm list` | `/vsafemobs list` | List tracked mobs | `vsafemobs.admin` |
| `/vsm reload` | `/vsafemobs reload` | Reload plugin | `vsafemobs.admin` |

---

## 🔒 Permissions

- `vsafemobs.spawn` - Spawn safe mobs (default: op)
- `vsafemobs.admin` - Kill, list, reload commands (default: op)

---

## 📝 Usage Examples

```bash
# Friendly Warden pet that can be leashed
/vsm spawn warden noattack:true leadable:true name:"&6Guardian" scale:0.8

# Invulnerable baby zombie
/vsm spawn zombie noattack:true invulnerable:true baby:true glow:true name:"&cTiny"

# Custom scaled ravager
/vsm spawn ravager noattack:true scale:0.5 health:100 name:"&7Mini Ravager"

# Silent decoration mob
/vsm spawn allay noattack:true silent:true persistent:true glow:true
```
